q.en: Which is the correct meaning of the Korean news term “무죄” (not guilty)?

exp.en: “무죄” (not guilty) means: Finding not guilty at trial.

q.ko: 오늘 뉴스에 나온 ‘탄핵’의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
q.en: Which is the correct meaning of the Korean news term “탄핵” (impeachment)?

exp.ko: ‘탄핵’은 “대통령·판사 같은 고위 공직자가 법을 어겼을 때 국회가 파면을 요구하는 절차”라는 뜻이에요.
exp.en: “탄핵” (impeachment) means: A procedure for the National Assembly to request the dismissal of high-ranking public officials, such as the president or judge, when they break the law.

ko: 국회 국방위원회를 이끄는 국회의원. 국방부·군 관련 법안과 예산 심사를 진행해요

q.ko: 오늘 뉴스에 나온 ‘기준금리’의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
q.en: Which is the correct meaning of the Korean news term “기준금리” (base interest rate)?

exp.ko: ‘기준금리’는 “한국은행이 정하는 돈의 기본 가격. 대출·예금 금리의 출발점”이라는 뜻이에요.
exp.en: “기준금리” (base interest rate) means: The basic price of money set by the Bank of Korea. Starting point of loan and deposit interest rates.

ko: 한국은행이 정하는 돈의 기본 가격. 대출·예금 금리의 출발점
나라가 수출·수입, 해외 투자 소득 등으로 번 돈과 쓴 돈의 차이
추가경정예산. 한 해 예산이 정해진 뒤 돈이 더 필요할 때 다시 짜는 예산
en: The basic price of money set by the Bank of Korea. Starting point of loan and deposit interest rates
The difference between the money a country earns through exports, imports, overseas investment income, etc., and the money it spends.
A meeting at the Bank of Korea to decide on the base interest rate. Open 8 times a year
Supplementary budget. After a year's budget is set, a budget is re-drafted when more money is needed.

q.en: The Korean term “관세” (tariff) means: “A phenomenon in which the price of goods continues to rise overall”.

exp.ko: ‘관세’의 뜻은 “다른 나라에서 들어오는 물건에 매기는 세금”예요.
exp.en: “관세” (tariff) means “Tax on goods coming from another country”.
